end.summary:
Practised average speed using total distance ÷ total time; calculated 20 m/s and 40 km/h correctly.
Practised average velocity as displacement ÷ time and identified displacement as zero on returning to the start.
Explained that velocity includes direction and identified west as negative direction.
Calculated braking acceleration as (0 − 25)/5 = −5 m/s², but continued to say slowing down means there is no acceleration.
Teach-back was not passed; requested number-line, drawing, and game-based examples.
end.parentNote: Asha practised speed, velocity, displacement, direction, and the acceleration formula using number lines and worked examples. Diya correctly used total distance ÷ total time, found zero displacement on a return trip, and recognised that changing direction changes velocity. They mixed up braking acceleration with there being no acceleration; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson.
